study_design: Integrated network of hospital-based case-control studies
reason: The abstract reports a processed-meat association for prostate cancer overall. It does not define or analyze high-grade, advanced, metastatic, lethal, or otherwise aggressive prostate cancer. The number of controls specific to the prostate cancer analysis is not provided, so its total analytic sample cannot be established.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: The OR for the highest (≥20 g/d) compared with lowest (<10 g/d) category of processed meat consumption was 1.16 (95% CI 1.06-1.28) for breast, 1.31 (95% CI 1.07-1.60) for endometrial, 1.49 (95% CI 1.30-1.71) for ovarian, and 0.89 (95% CI 0.74-1.07) for prostate cancer.
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate is for prostate cancer overall and contains no aggressive-disease restriction.
